# Dependencies

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Google Play Services Location (`com.google.android.gms:play-services-location:21.3.0`) | `FusedLocationProviderClient` GPS fix sampling (`service/LocationForegroundService.kt`) |
| Google Maps SDK for Android (`com.google.android.gms:play-services-maps:19.0.0`) | Renders the session's recorded route on-screen; API key from `local.properties` `MAPS_API_KEY`, meta-data in `AndroidManifest.xml` |
| `android.location.Geocoder` (Android platform API, no third-party dependency) | Reverse-geocodes a session's first point to a place name (`service/AndroidReverseGeocoder.kt`) |

### Internal libraries

No first-party/private library modules exist — `settings.gradle.kts` includes only the single
`app` module; there is no `:core`, `:data`, or similar internal Gradle module to list.

### Shared infrastructure

| Infrastructure | Role |
|---|---|
| Room 2.6.1 (SQLite) | Local persistence of sessions and GPS points (`data/local/AppDatabase.kt`) — no external DB server |
| DataStore Preferences 1.1.1 | Local, on-device user settings storage (`data/settings/SettingsRepository.kt`) |
| Android foreground `Service` | Long-running background GPS collection independent of the Activity (`service/LocationForegroundService.kt`), `foregroundServiceType="location"` |
| kotlinx-coroutines-android / -play-services 1.8.1 | Coroutine dispatchers and Play Services Task→coroutine bridging used throughout `service/` and `domain/` |

No message queue, cache server (Redis/Memcached), or observability/APM dependency (Sentry,
Firebase Crashlytics, etc.) appears in `gradle/libs.versions.toml` or `app/build.gradle.kts`.
